albumReady.subtitle: Once all the photos have arrived, let your guests know: those who left their e-mail get the link to the album.

liveCard.subtitle: Show the photos on a screen or projector during the party: new ones appear by themselves, with the QR code in a corner. Only approved photos are shown.

downloadCard.subtitle: All the photos and videos visible in the album, in ZIP files of 2 GB at most. The ZIPs are built in your browser, straight from the storage: your photos go through no server.
